title: 第393章 求求你，别离开我
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

秦然停在了原地。

大夏龙雀上的剑光散尽，穹顶的仙宫也已消失不见。

他抱着手中残破娇躯，整个人仿佛丢了魂儿……眼中是一片陌生的空白，脸上没有一丁点血色残留。

“陛下……”虚弱的呢喃声，在这死寂的天地间被无限放大。

秦然浑身一震，惊恐的低下头。

在低头的一瞬，他那通红的眼眶再也拦不住决堤的泪水，豆大的眼泪吧嗒吧嗒的滴在了女人苍白的脸颊上。

“香香！”

“求你别出事，香香！！！”

他慌得没有了分寸。

手足无措。

空间戒指中的宝贝倒满一地，手忙脚乱的在其中扒拉着，取出一瓶瓶保命丹药，胡乱的往女人的口中塞。

丹药洒落一地，瓶子叮叮当当。

“香香，快咽下去，求求你快咽下去。”

丹药入口，融化开来，但没有效果。

帝狐的狐爪上，似带有某种毁灭之力，早已将香香体内脏器碾碎，生机也被磨灭殆尽……

秦然崩溃嘶吼。

“系统！”

“系统！！”

“系统，你快出来！！！”

他泣声嘶喊着，但无声回应。

“小云云！对，还有小云云！”

“小云云，你快出来，你快来救救香香！！”

女人在一旁浮现而出，轻轻叹气，“抱歉，她生机已绝，救不了……”

“为什么！！！”秦然彻底崩溃了。

“啊！！！！”

“为什么！！！！”

他紧攥着香香冰凉的手，紧紧贴在自己的脸上，眼泪已模糊了视线。

“傻狐狸！你是不是傻！”

“刚才她的攻击，我能躲开的，你为什么要挡！！”

“为什么……”

香香在笑。

她已虚弱到只能勉强眯着眼睛，嘴角那一抹小小的弧度，能勉强看出来她是在笑。

“别哭…抱着我…我冷……”

“好，香香，你别睡，朕抱着你！”

秦然小心翼翼地搂着女人，不敢用一点力气，生怕将这残破之躯给揉碎了。

看着女人胸口的狰狞血洞，看着其中已爆碎殆尽的脏器，他的泪腺崩了，眼泪怎么也止不住了……

Page (1/3)

Qin Ran stopped where he was.

The sword light on Daxia Longque disappeared, and the fairy palace on the dome also disappeared.

He held the broken body in his hands, as if he had lost his soul... There was an unfamiliar blankness in his eyes, and there was not a trace of blood left on his face.

"Your Majesty..." The weak murmur was infinitely amplified in this dead world.

Qin Ran was shocked and lowered his head in horror.

The moment he lowered his head, his red eyes could no longer hold back the bursting tears, and the big tears fell on the woman's pale cheeks.

"Xiangxiang!"

"Please don't let anything happen to you, Xiangxiang!!!"

He was so panicked that he lost all control.

At a loss.

The treasures in the space ring were poured all over the floor. He hurriedly dug through them, took out bottles of life-saving elixirs, and randomly stuffed them into the woman's mouth.

The pills were scattered all over the floor, and the bottles were clinking.

"Xiangxiang, swallow it quickly, please swallow it quickly."

The elixir melted in my mouth, but had no effect.

The Emperor Fox's claws seemed to contain some kind of destructive power. It had already crushed Xiangxiang's internal organs and wiped out all her vitality...

Qin Ran collapsed and roared.

"System!"

"System!!"

"System, come out quickly!!!"

He screamed and cried, but there was no response.

"Xiao Yunyun! Yes, there is also Xiao Yunyun!"

"Xiao Yunyun, come out quickly, come and save Xiangxiang!!"

A woman emerged from the side and sighed softly, "Sorry, her life is at an end and cannot be saved..."

"Why!!!" Qin Ran collapsed completely.

"Ah!!!!"

"Why!!!"

He clutched Xiangxiang's cold hand and pressed it tightly against his face, his vision blurred by tears.

"Silly fox! Are you stupid!"

"I could dodge her attack just now, why did you block it!!"

"Why..."

Xiangxiang is smiling.

She was so weak that she could only squint her eyes, and the small curve at the corner of her mouth showed that she was smiling.

"Don't cry...hold me...I'm cold..."

"Okay, Xiangxiang, don't sleep, I'll hold you!"

Qin Ran hugged the woman carefully, not daring to use any strength for fear of crushing the broken body.

Looking at the ferocious bloody hole in the woman's chest and the exploded organs inside, his tear ducts collapsed and he couldn't stop crying...
